title: Telemetry Activation Guide
description: Learn how to enable telemetry collection on your device

steps.title: Open the Unetwork App
steps.description: Launch the Unetwork app on your mobile device. You'll see the main dashboard with your current status and available tasks.

steps.title: Navigate to Tasks
steps.description: Tap on the Tasks icon in the bottom navigation bar to view all available earning opportunities.

steps.title: Telemetry is Always Active
steps.description: Connection to Unetwork is enabled by default and keeps your device continuously connected to participate in ongoing Unetwork tasks. No additional setup required!
